title: Puppet Master Section 15 Browser Program Contracts
description: Typed static contracts for PM Browser Script compilation, BrowserProgram execution, ProgramWorkspace, exact-generation representation/query, controller fencing, reconstructive handoff, routing, routines, isolated adapters, the fifteen canonical Browser command request/result/error/availability/disabled-reason records, receipts, and ObservableWork. The aggregate $id identifies this union schema only; each payload carries its unique record-addressable schema_id. Central catalog registration, native handlers, production wiring, Event Authority admission, and runtime proof are outside this schema.

x-pm-legacy-schema-id-migration.migration_rule: An explicit pre-validation migrator must first validate an exact known record_kind and then replace the legacy aggregate payload ID with that record kind's unique schema_id. Unknown or missing record_kind fails closed. The aggregate ID is never stored as a record schema identity.
